offering_description.value: Produces lithium chemicals, bromine-based specialty chemicals and refining catalysts, sold mainly to battery makers, chemical producers and oil refiners. It extracts raw materials and processes them into chemicals through its own plants and supplies them directly to industrial customers.

primary_products.value: lithium hydroxide; lithium carbonate; bromine; flame retardants; refining catalysts

primary_services.value: technical customer support; catalyst regeneration services

customer_segment.value: B2B: battery and electric vehicle makers, chemical producers, petroleum refiners, plastics and electronics manufacturers

end_markets.value: electric vehicles and energy storage; electronics; plastics and construction; petroleum refining; pharmaceuticals

revenue_model.value: product sales: lithium, bromine and catalyst chemicals sold under supply contracts and on the spot market; service fees: catalyst regeneration and technical services for refinery customers

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: takes in lithium brine and ore and bromine feedstocks from its own extraction operations; OEM / manufacturer: processes raw materials into chemicals and catalysts, sold to battery makers and industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: Production in the United States, Chile, China and other countries, sales to customers worldwide

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses: lithium, bromine specialties and refining catalysts, each with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term supply contracts with battery makers and large chemical customers; distributors / dealers: chemical distributors serving smaller industrial customers; own locations: company-owned plants and production sites supplying products directly
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining and chemical plant environmental permits, chemical safety and trade rules such as REACH and TSCA

notes: Portfolio of the refining catalysts business may have changed recently, so its current scope is uncertain.
